sections.title: Tree and leaves
sections.text: Pterospermum acerifolium is a tree that can reach about 30 m. Its large, maple-like leaves are variable and may measure about 18–30 × 14–20 cm.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: Large fragrant white flowers have petals about 10–11 cm long. The woody, spindle-shaped capsule can reach 15 cm and contains winged seeds.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The sources consulted describe ornamental and timber uses; they do not establish a food use for the flowers or other parts.
